|lore=Ubrikkian sail barge. Custom built for Jabba with an armored hull and weaponry. Top speed of 100 kph. Used by the Hutt crimelord on his many trips to Mos Eisley.
|game_text=Deploys only on Tatooine. Once per turn, you may ▼ Passenger Deck, Jabba, or Pote aboard. May add 8 passengers. Your aliens deploy -1 aboard. Scum And Villainy may deploy here. Immune to attrition while Passenger Deck on table. May add 1 driver.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Jabba's Sail Barge (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Jabba's Sail Barge (V) (Virtual Set 8)]]): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 3, slip 38 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “Deploys only on Tatooine. Once per turn, you may ▼ Passenger Deck, Jabba, or Pote aboard. May add 8 passengers. Your aliens deploy -1 aboard. Scum And Villainy may deploy here. Immune to attrition while Passenger Deck on table.” Stats line: “POWER 4 ARMOR 5 LANDSPEED 2”. Deploy 3, forfeit 5. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•38” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): a post by Kevin Brownell (“CubsFan”), the Committee's Marketing & Player Relations Advocate in the Committee's forum thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (“official rulings and errata issued by the Rules Committee”), 30 March 2006 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617231905/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4438 Internet Archive capture of 17 June 2006]): “This card's gametext is being erratad to include the following text: "May add 1 driver." This text was left off the card by mistake.” The post gives only the added sentence, “May add 1 driver.”, and does not say where it goes; the game text on this page is the 24 November 2004 slip's text with that sentence added at the end. There is no slip image (forum post). '''What changed:''' “May add 1 driver.” was added.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Jabba's Sail Barge (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata 2)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 38), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploys only on Tatooine. May add 1 driver and 8 passengers. Scum And Villainy may deploy aboard. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Jabba, Pote, or Passenger Deck aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 6.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
